description:
At a banquet, guests playfully present Yuna with a ribbon-adorned chicken plushie after seeing her carrying platters.
"Being cute doesn't excuse everything!"
Yuna's face turns bright red. A special day when her relationship with everyone changed just a little bit.
name: Red-Faced Knight

description:
Established order and granted peace. Such things are merely a cage to imprison me.
That's precisely why I'll destroy it all, with the alchemical power I've learned and accumulated. I wield this power only to satisfy my own desires.
Now, let us begin—the battle for "liberation."
name: Thirst for Liberation

description:
Resna's staff emits a dazzling light.
"Behold! The magnificent power of alchemy!"
She thrusts her staff toward the enemies blocking her path.
Having grown as an alchemist through her journey, she faces the future of alchemy with unwavering determination in her eyes.
name: Light of Alchemy

description:
"Ugh! You guys are so persistent!"
Marlone finds herself surrounded by monsters with no escape route.
But she doesn't panic. After all—
"Time to bring out the big guns! Marlone's Special Mega Flame! Take this!"
She is, after all, the explosive girl who will make her name known throughout the world.
name: The Explosive Girl Marie Arrives!

description:
"Judith! Enemies coming from this way!"
"I know! Hyaaaaaah!!"
Judith travels with Fink the parrot.
"I won't lose here!"
Her adventure, spanning over 200 years, has only just begun.
name: Beyond Distant Time

description:
Happy New Year.
Lately, there have been many unsettling events occurring one after another. I must do my best to ensure everyone can live without worry or anxiety.
May this year bring happiness and wonder to this star.
name: Happiness to This Star

description:
"Done! Look, look, Plachta!"
"Sophie... what are you doing?"
"I found an old recipe in the back of the shelf, so I thought I'd try it..."
"We're in the middle of spring cleaning! Why are you making such a mess!"
name: An Endless Journey

description:
Marlone's alchemical skills have earned her a teaching position at the academy. While she enjoys her fulfilling life as a teacher, her busy days sometimes make her long for a break...
"Maybe I should invite her out to eat sometime..."
The face of her kind friend floats into her mind.
name: Unchanging Friendship

description:
Empel is appointed as Lara's secretary on a trial basis.
"Are you prepared to serve tea at the meeting?"
"Yes, flawlessly. The tea snacks are also ready."
"Excellent, you pass! Now, about signing a contract as an official secretary of the Lara Kingdom..."
"Lady Lara, thank you for having me, brief though it was."
name: Your Excellency, It's Meeting Time

description:
"Firis~"
"Waaah! What is it, Il-chan?"
"Nothing~? Your arm just looked so pinchable right in front of me!"
"Hehe, what's that about? You're weird."
"Ah, no fair! Big sis, let me pinch you too~!"
name: Me Too, Me Too~!

description: New sights, new encounters, thrilling adventures... While such stimulating days are fun, sometimes it's nice to take a break and catch your breath. Reflecting on past events while chatting with companions—that too is part of the journey's flavor.
name: Days Like These Sometimes

description:
—A world of light and darkness, order and chaos, where swords and magic intertwine.
In a corner of such a world lived an alchemist. She knew nothing of the world's rise and fall. Yet, the footsteps she had walked were surely etched in that place.
name: Where She Once Stood

description:
Taking a break in a quiet shade, a cool breeze blows through as flower petals dance in the air. A slightly special moment in an otherwise ordinary day.
It's small but precious happiness. Surely from this will come a magical recipe to make tomorrow even more enjoyable.
name: Magical Recipe

description:
The world is made of various colors. Taking each color in hand, letting the brush run freely across the canvas as the heart desires. Colors overlap and blend, vividly painting stories.
Now then, what shall we create today?
name: A Colored World

description:
Walking through this barren land where dry winds blow, searching for someone precious. Using blooming and scattered flowers as guides, watching the waxing and waning moon, all the way to the distant horizon.
Believing that surely, we'll meet you there.
name: To the Distant Horizon

description: Let's gather a friend or two and set out. Tomorrow surely awaits beyond that door. Let's join hands and sing together. Under the sparkling sky, let's go meet the hopeful morning sun. Forward, forward, down this endless road. We'll surely reach our dreamed future.
name: Toward the Dreamed Future

description:
Closing my eyes, I remember those irreplaceable days. Though I can't see them now, that child, she, he, everyone is by my side, pushing me toward the next world.
I feel like I heard a voice saying "Let's go."
Well then, let me lace up my boots. A new adventure begins—
name: Anytime, Anywhere.

description:
Books are collections of knowledge woven for someone's happiness. My role is to mix this knowledge together to discover recipes for happiness.
Come, tell me your dreams. No matter how impossible they seem, it's okay. I know that if we take it one step at a time, they'll definitely come true.
name: Where Knowledge Gathers

description:
"Hehe. That looks delicious."
"Would you like some, Sophie? In that case..."
Plachta takes a piece of candy and offers it.
"Really? Then without hesitation... say 'aah'"
"Ah! Geez, that tickles..."
A warm sweetness melts in their mouths.
name: In Sweet Cloudiness

description:
"Well then, let's head out today too!"
Ryza always takes my hand and leads me on adventures. Our relationship hasn't changed since we first met. But now, I want to be even closer.
"W-wait, Klaudia?! If you stick so close, it'll be hard to walk..."
name: Closer Than Back Then

description:
When one adventure ends, another awaits. After all, this world is still filled with countless mysteries.
As long as curiosity remains, the adventures will never end.
Now then, onto the next stage—
name: A New Journey Begins

description:
How long has it been since we first met?
Joy, sorrow, happiness, hardship—we've shared it all together.
The time I've spent with you is precious to me.
And I dream of a wonderful future where these moments continue forever—
name: Dreams of Something Special

description:
Adding a secret ingredient to the usual recipe.
Thinking of that person's smiling face, I can't help but smile myself.
Now, let's stir in the finishing touch,
with plenty of love mixed in.
name: A Pinch of Love

description:
Just the two of us beneath the starlit sky.
Adventuring with everyone is fun, but today is different—a special adventure just for us.
It's as if we're the only two people in the world.
May this quiet, warm moment last until dawn—
name: A Special Adventure

description:
A small reward after finishing work.
The sweetness of cake melts away the day's fatigue.
But really, I don't even need the cake.
Just having you beside me makes me so happy that I forget all about being tired.
name: After Work Moments

description:
"Oh? Are you lost? Let Alvie be your guide! Don't worry about payment—it's off the clock! Though if you insist on showing your gratitude—"
"Alvina? Should I report this to the High Priest?"
"J-just kidding, Janne! It was just a joke..."
name: Leave It to Alvie!

description:
Sacred Knight Bepp Zimlock.
Beneath her cold gaze,
her blade moves with bestial ferocity,
hunting, catching, and slaying her prey.
And within each swing lies her conviction—
name: Blade of Conviction

description:
The words we exchanged, the scenery we saw together.
I remember every moment we spent together.
But it's still not enough.
There are words I still want to tell you.
There are sights I still want to see with you.
So please—
name: Stone of Creation

description:
During a break between duties, Janne sits down to rest her weary body. Even the one called the strongest warrior shows a gentler, motherly side when away from the battlefield.
"Oh? Hehe, did you come to see me?"
Her face brightens even more at the sight of someone rushing over.
(That gave me an energy boost♪ I can keep going now!)
name: Holy Knight's Respite

description:
Steadfastly, I've pressed forward to master this path.
It began with inspiration in my youth. And the more I learned, the deeper I delved into this profound and mysterious world.
Even when doubts arise, this power guides me forward. It has until now, and surely will continue to do so.
name: Single-Minded Devotion

description:
The curtain rises on a new adventure.
Filled with both anticipation and anxiety, we look toward the endless sea beyond. What could be waiting for us beyond that horizon?
name: What Awaits Beyond the Sea

description:
I don't know what the right answer is. After all, I don't even know anything about myself.
But I refuse to just accept that and give up. Even if it's just a little at a time, I want to find the answers with my own hands.
Well, thinking isn't really my style... For now, I'll carve my path forward with this sword!
name: With My Own Hands
